verdict.rationale: Vercel's own vercel/vercel GitHub repository, which holds the Vercel CLI and framework builders, is published under Apache License 2.0, so part of the product's source is readable under an open license. The hosted platform itself (deployment infrastructure, dashboard, AI Gateway, Sandbox) has no open-source code in the evidence. Missing for 10: open-licensed source for the core hosted platform, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how much of the product is actually open.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
